strings.title: DREF DECISION TREE - DREF FUNDING OPTIONS
strings.disclaimer: For guidance purposes only, and under consideration that both the National Society and the disaster are eligible for DREF. Always coordinate with your Delegation and DREF Focal Point.
strings.deadEndMessage: No recommendation is configured for this path yet. Please coordinate with your Delegation and DREF Focal Point.
strings.questionNature: What is the nature of the disaster?
strings.questionSize: What size of operation are you aiming at?
strings.questionEnoughInfo: Do you have enough information to justify the response?
strings.questionDroughtFocusResponse: Are you responding specifically to drought, food insecurity, or water shortages?
strings.questionDroughtFocusAnticipatory: Are you anticipating specifically the impacts of drought, food insecurity, or water shortages?
strings.questionHasEap: Does the National Society have an Early Action Protocol in place?
strings.questionEapTrigger: Has the pre-agreed trigger of the EAP been reached?
strings.questionRiskThreshold: Is the level of risk similar to the EAP threshold?
strings.questionGeoCoverage: Is the geographical coverage the same as indicated in the EAP?
strings.questionAlertRelated: Is the alert related to a slow-onset hazard, civil unrest, election readiness or epidemic?
strings.noteEmergencyAppealUnavailable: Please note that currently Emergency Appeals cannot be done through the IFRC GO platform.
strings.noteAdvancePayment: As this is a sudden-onset event, your National Society may also request an advance payment while developing the DREF Application.
strings.noteRecurrentEvents: For recurrent events, your National Society may need to provide additional information or justification for the use of DREF.
strings.noteConductAssessment: If not using the Assessment-type DREF Application form, conduct a further assessment before applying for DREF.
strings.noteInsufficientEvidence: If evidence is insufficient to justify a full response, consider an Assessment DREF allocation first to generate the necessary evidence before scaling up the intervention.
strings.noteEapActivationByEmail: Please note that currently the EAP Activation process cannot be done through the IFRC GO platform. Kindly submit your activation notification through the following email address: dref.anticipatorypillar@ifrc.org
strings.noteJustifyExceptionalApproval: Make sure to include all the necessary information to justify the exceptional approval.
strings.noteLinkFollowingResources: Check the following resources for more details.
strings.outcomeDroughtDref: Consider Response DREF focused on Drought disaster type
strings.outcomeExceptionalApproval: Potentially eligible for exceptional approval for the EAP Activation
strings.outcomeDevelopEap: Consider developing an Early Action Protocol
